decisions.choice: Jehu son of Hanani: a prophet in the northern kingdom
decisions.reason: This Jehu is not the later King Jehu (2 Kings 9). He is called "the prophet" in verses 7 and 12. A seer named Hanani spoke against Asa king of Judah (2 Chronicles 16:7), and Jehu son of Hanani later rebuked Jehoshaphat (2 Chronicles 19:2; 20:34).

decisions.choice: against Baasha: the prophet who condemned Jeroboam's house is followed by one who condemns Baasha's
decisions.reason: Baasha had seized the throne by killing Nadab and wiping out the house of Jeroboam, as Ahijah had foretold (15:27-30; 14:10-11). Now the same kind of word is spoken against Baasha himself.

decisions.choice: gave a message ... The LORD said
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that the LORD gave the prophet a message, and names the speaker of the words that follow.

decisions.choice: "Jehú hijo de Hananí"
decisions.reason: Jehú as the Kings and Chronicles terms table sets for the king; the prophet bears the same name and takes the same form.

decisions.choice: "Jéhu fils de Hanani"
decisions.reason: The prophet bears the same name as the later king, Jéhu in the terms note; Hanani in the usual French spelling.

decisions.choice: "Giê-hu con trai Ha-na-ni"
decisions.reason: The prophet takes the same form as the later king Jehu in the terms note; "con trai Ha-na-ni" keeps the two apart.

decisions.choice: Jeú, filho de Hanani
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the prophet (m1) bears the same name as the later King Jehu, "Jeú" in the shared list for Kings, and his father is "Hanani", a name Portuguese can write as it stands.

source.text: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֲרִימֹתִ֨יךָ֙ מִן־הֶ֣עָפָ֔ר וָאֶתֶּנְךָ֣ נָגִ֔יד עַ֖ל עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַתֵּ֣לֶךְ׀בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יָרָבְעָ֗ם וַֽתַּחֲטִא֙ אֶת־עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְהַכְעִיסֵ֖נִי בְּחַטֹּאתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Because that I raised you from the dust and made you ruler over my people Israel, and you have walked in [the] way of Jeroboam and made sin my people Israel, to provoke me with their sins,

en.L: "Because I lifted you up from the dust and made you ruler over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have made {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel sin, to provoke {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to anger with their sins,
en.B: "I lifted you up from the dust and made you ruler over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel. Yet you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and led {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel to sin, provoking {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to anger with their sins.
en.R: "I lifted you up from nothing and made you the leader of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel. But you have lived the way Jeroboam lived, and you have led {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel into sin. They have made {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} angry with their sins.

es.L: «Por cuanto yo te levanté del polvo y te puse por gobernante sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel, y tú has andado en el camino de Jeroboam y has hecho pecar a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel, para provocarme a ira con sus pecados,
es.B: «Yo te levanté del polvo y te hice gobernante sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel. Pero tú has seguido el camino de Jeroboam y has hecho pecar a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel, provocándome a ira con sus pecados.
es.R: «Yo te levanté de la nada y te hice líder de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel. Pero tú has vivido como vivió Jeroboam, y has hecho pecar a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel. Ellos {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} han hecho enojar con sus pecados.

fr.L: « Parce que je t’ai élevé de la poussière et que je t’ai fait chef sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël, et que tu as marché dans la voie de Jéroboam et que tu as fait pécher {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël, pour {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}irriter par leurs péchés,
fr.B: « Je t’ai élevé de la poussière et je t’ai fait chef de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël. Mais tu as marché dans la voie de Jéroboam et tu as entraîné {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël à pécher, de sorte qu’ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}irritent par leurs péchés.
fr.R: « Tu n’étais rien, et je t’ai élevé et fait chef de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël. Mais tu as vécu comme Jéroboam, et tu as entraîné {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël dans le péché. Leurs péchés {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont mis en colère.

sw.L: "Kwa kuwa nilikuinua kutoka mavumbini nikakufanya kiongozi juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli, nawe umeenda katika njia ya Yeroboamu na kuwafanya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli watende dhambi, ili kunikasirisha kwa dhambi zao,
sw.B: "Nilikuinua kutoka mavumbini nikakufanya kiongozi juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli. Lakini wewe umeenda katika njia ya Yeroboamu na kuwaongoza watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli kutenda dhambi, ukinikasirisha kwa dhambi zao.
sw.R: "Nilikuinua kutoka hali ya kutokuwa kitu, nikakufanya kiongozi wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli. Lakini wewe umeishi kama Yeroboamu alivyoishi, na umewaongoza watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli kutenda dhambi. Wamenikasirisha kwa dhambi zao.

vi.L: "Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã nhấc ngươi lên từ bụi đất và lập ngươi làm người lãnh đạo dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, mà ngươi đã đi theo đường lối của Giê-rô-bô-am và khiến dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phạm tội, để chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bởi tội lỗi của chúng,
vi.B: "Ta đã nhấc ngươi lên từ bụi đất và lập ngươi làm người lãnh đạo dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Thế mà ngươi đã đi theo đường lối của Giê-rô-bô-am và khiến dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phạm tội, chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bởi tội lỗi của chúng.
vi.R: "Ta đã nâng ngươi lên từ chỗ không ra gì và lập ngươi làm người lãnh đạo dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Nhưng ngươi đã sống như Giê-rô-bô-am và đưa dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vào tội lỗi. Tội lỗi của chúng đã làm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nổi giận.

ko.L: "내가 너를 티끌에서 들어 올려 내 백성 이스라엘 위에 지도자로 세웠으나, 너는 여로보암의 길로 걸었고 내 백성 이스라엘에게 죄를 짓게 하여, 그들의 죄로 나를 노엽게 했다.
ko.B: "내가 너를 티끌에서 들어 올려 내 백성 이스라엘의 지도자로 세웠다. 그런데 너는 여로보암의 길로 걸으며 내 백성 이스라엘에게 죄를 짓게 했고, 그들의 죄로 나를 노엽게 했다.
ko.R: "나는 보잘것없던 너를 들어 올려 내 백성 이스라엘의 지도자로 세웠다. 그러나 너는 여로보암이 살던 대로 살았고, 내 백성 이스라엘에게 죄를 짓게 했다. 그들은 자기들의 죄로 나를 화나게 했다.

pt.L: "Porque eu te levantei do pó e te fiz príncipe sobre o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel, e tu andaste no caminho de Jeroboão e fizeste o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel pecar, para {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} provocar à ira com os pecados deles,
pt.B: "Eu te levantei do pó e te fiz príncipe sobre o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel. Mas tu andaste no caminho de Jeroboão e fizeste o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel pecar, provocando-{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} à ira com os pecados deles.
pt.R: "Eu te tirei do nada e te fiz chefe do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel. Mas tu viveste como Jeroboão viveu e levaste o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel a pecar. Eles {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} deixaram irado com os seus pecados.

decisions.choice: raised you from the dust: lifted you from a low and unknown place
decisions.reason: Dust stands for the lowest place (1 Samuel 2:8). Baasha came from an unimportant family of the tribe of Issachar (15:27), and Yahweh says he owes his throne to him.

decisions.choice: ruler: the one appointed by Yahweh to lead his people
decisions.reason: The word *nagid* names a leader whom Yahweh has chosen and set over his people, as with Saul, David and Jeroboam (1 Samuel 9:16; 2 Samuel 7:8; 14:7). Baasha's throne was his to hold under Yahweh.

decisions.choice: walked in the way of Jeroboam and made Israel sin: the standing charge against the kings of Israel
decisions.reason: Jeroboam made the golden calves at Bethel and Dan and led Israel to worship there (12:28-33). From now on, Kings judges each king of Israel by whether he kept to this sin and led the people into it (verses 13, 19, 26). The verb "made sin" is causative: the king led the nation to sin.

decisions.choice: to provoke me to anger: so that Yahweh is roused to anger
decisions.reason: The verb means to vex or rouse to anger. It is the second half of the standing charge: the people's sin angers Yahweh (14:9, 15; verses 7, 13, 26, 33).

decisions.choice: made ... sin (Literal); led ... to sin (Balanced); led ... into sin (Readable); provoke to anger (Literal, Balanced); made angry (Readable)
decisions.reason: These two formulas recur through the chapter and through Kings; each level keeps one wording for them, as at 14:9 and 14:16 (verses 13, 19, 26, 33).

decisions.choice: from nothing
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of the dust as a lowly beginning.

decisions.choice: "m’irriter" (L, B); "m’ont mis en colère" (R)
decisions.reason: One wording per level for "provoke to anger", which recurs through Kings: "irriter" at Literal and Balanced, "mettre en colère" at Readable.

decisions.choice: kutoka hali ya kutokuwa kitu
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the picture "kutoka mavumbini" (from the dust); Readable gives its sense, "from being nothing", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "보잘것없던 너를" (R); "티끌에서" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Readable says what being lifted from the dust means, as the English "from nothing" does.

decisions.choice: tu (the LORD to Baasha); te levantei do pó (L, B), te tirei do nada (R); príncipe (L, B), chefe (R)
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks to Baasha with "tu", as he spoke to Jeroboam (14:7-9). The wording of 14:7 and 14:9 is kept for the parallel charge (m1-m4), so that the reader hears the same sentence passed on a second king.

source.text: הִנְנִ֥י מַבְעִ֛יר אַחֲרֵ֥י בַעְשָׁ֖א וְאַחֲרֵ֣י בֵית֑וֹ וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ אֶת־בֵּ֣יתְךָ֔ כְּבֵ֖ית יָרָבְעָ֥ם בֶּן־נְבָֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, I [am] sweeping away after Baasha and after his house, and I will make your house like [the] house of Jeroboam son of Nebat.

en.L: look, I [am] about to sweep away after Baasha and after his house, and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat.
en.B: So I am about to sweep away Baasha and his house after him, and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat.
en.R: So I am going to wipe out Baasha and his family. I will make your family like the family of Jeroboam son of Nebat.

es.L: he aquí que yo barreré detrás de Baasa y detrás de su casa, y haré tu casa como la casa de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat.
es.B: Por eso voy a barrer a Baasa y a su casa después de él, y haré a tu casa como la casa de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat.
es.R: Por eso voy a acabar con Baasa y con su familia. Haré con tu familia lo mismo que hice con la familia de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat.

fr.L: voici, je vais balayer derrière Baésha et derrière sa maison, et je rendrai ta maison semblable à la maison de Jéroboam fils de Nebath.
fr.B: je vais donc balayer Baésha et sa maison après lui, et je rendrai ta maison semblable à la maison de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath.
fr.R: Alors je vais faire disparaître Baésha et sa famille. Je ferai à ta famille ce que j’ai fait à la famille de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath.

sw.L: tazama, mimi [ninakaribia] kufagilia mbali nyuma ya Baasha na nyuma ya nyumba yake, nami nitaifanya nyumba yako kama nyumba ya Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo nitamfagilia mbali Baasha na nyumba yake baada yake, nami nitaifanya nyumba yako kama nyumba ya Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nitamwangamiza Baasha na jamaa yake. Nitaifanya jamaa yako kama jamaa ya Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati.

vi.L: kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp quét sạch Ba-ê-sa và nhà nó, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho nhà ngươi giống như nhà Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát.
vi.B: Vì vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp quét sạch Ba-ê-sa và nhà nó, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho nhà ngươi giống như nhà Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát.
vi.R: Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp tiêu diệt Ba-ê-sa và gia đình nó. Ta sẽ làm cho gia đình ngươi giống như gia đình Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát.

ko.L: 보아라, 내가 바아사와 그의 집을 뒤따라가 쓸어 버리고, 네 집을 느밧의 아들 여로보암의 집처럼 만들겠다.
ko.B: 그러므로 내가 바아사와 그의 집안을 뒤쫓아 쓸어 버리겠다. 네 집안을 느밧의 아들 여로보암의 집안처럼 만들겠다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 바아사와 그의 집안을 없애 버리겠다. 네 집안을 느밧의 아들 여로보암의 집안처럼 만들겠다.

pt.L: eis que eu [estou] para varrer [o que fica] depois de Baasa e depois da sua casa, e farei a tua casa como a casa de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate.
pt.B: Por isso vou varrer Baasa e a sua casa depois dele, e farei a tua casa como a casa de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate.
pt.R: Por isso vou acabar com Baasa e com a família dele. Vou fazer com a tua família o que fiz com a família de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate.

decisions.choice: sweep away after: clear away to the last trace
decisions.reason: The verb means to burn up or to clear out completely. With "after" it pictures clearing away everything that is left, as Ahijah said of Jeroboam's house: "as one burns up dung until it is all gone" (14:10).

decisions.choice: house: family and royal line
decisions.reason: "House" here means Baasha's family and descendants, the line that might have ruled after him, as with "the house of Jeroboam".

decisions.choice: after Baasha ... your house: Yahweh speaks of Baasha and then to him
decisions.reason: The sentence moves from speaking about Baasha to speaking to him directly, a change of person that is common in Hebrew speech.

decisions.choice: family
decisions.reason: Readable says "family" for "house" in the sense of a royal line.

decisions.choice: So
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable divide the long sentence of verses 2-3 and join the judgment to its reasons with "So".

decisions.choice: varrer [o que fica] depois de
decisions.reason: The verb of 14:10 (m1), which Balanced rendered "varrer" there, is "varrer" at Literal and Balanced here, where the comparison with burning is not repeated; Readable says "acabar com". The LORD speaks of Baasha and then to him (m3), as the Hebrew does.

source.text: הַמֵּ֤ת לְבַעְשָׁא֙ בָּעִ֔יר יֹֽאכְל֖וּ הַכְּלָבִ֑ים וְהַמֵּ֥ת לוֹ֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה יֹאכְל֖וּ ע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: The one who dies of Baasha in the city, will eat the dogs; and the one who dies of him in the field, will eat [the] birds of the heavens."

en.L: The one belonging to Baasha who dies in the city, the dogs will eat; and the one belonging to him who dies in the field, the birds of the heavens will eat."
en.B: Anyone belonging to Baasha who dies in the city, the dogs will eat, and anyone of his who dies in the open country, the birds of the sky will eat."
en.R: Dogs will eat anyone in Baasha's family who dies in the city, and birds will eat anyone who dies out in the country."

es.L: Al que de Baasa muera en la ciudad, se lo comerán los perros; y al que de él muera en el campo, se lo comerán las aves de los cielos».
es.B: A cualquiera de los de Baasa que muera en la ciudad, se lo comerán los perros, y al que muera en el campo, se lo comerán las aves del cielo».
es.R: Los perros se comerán a cualquiera de la familia de Baasa que muera en la ciudad, y las aves se comerán a cualquiera que muera en el campo».

fr.L: Celui de Baésha qui mourra dans la ville, les chiens le mangeront ; et celui des siens qui mourra dans les champs, les oiseaux du ciel le mangeront. »
fr.B: Tout homme de Baésha qui mourra dans la ville sera mangé par les chiens, et celui des siens qui mourra dans la campagne sera mangé par les oiseaux du ciel. »
fr.R: Les chiens mangeront ceux de la famille de Baésha qui mourront en ville, et les oiseaux mangeront ceux qui mourront dans la campagne. »

sw.L: Aliye wa Baasha atakayekufa mjini, mbwa watamla; naye aliye wake atakayekufa shambani, ndege wa angani watamla."
sw.B: Yeyote wa Baasha atakayekufa mjini, mbwa watamla, na yeyote wake atakayekufa nyikani, ndege wa angani watamla."
sw.R: Mbwa watamla yeyote wa jamaa ya Baasha atakayekufa mjini, na ndege watamla yeyote atakayekufa porini."

vi.L: Kẻ thuộc về Ba-ê-sa chết trong thành, chó sẽ ăn; và kẻ thuộc về nó chết ngoài đồng, chim trời sẽ ăn."
vi.B: Ai thuộc nhà Ba-ê-sa chết trong thành sẽ bị chó ăn, ai thuộc nhà nó chết ngoài đồng sẽ bị chim trời ăn."
vi.R: Người nào trong gia đình Ba-ê-sa chết trong thành sẽ bị chó ăn, người nào chết ngoài đồng sẽ bị chim ăn."

ko.L: 바아사에게 속한 자로서 성읍에서 죽는 자는 개들이 먹고, 그에게 속한 자로서 들에서 죽는 자는 하늘의 새들이 먹을 것이다."
ko.B: 바아사에게 속한 사람이 성읍에서 죽으면 개들이 먹고, 들에서 죽으면 공중의 새들이 먹을 것이다."
ko.R: 바아사 집안 사람이 성 안에서 죽으면 개들이 먹고, 들에서 죽으면 새들이 먹을 것이다."

pt.L: O que pertencer a Baasa e morrer na cidade, os cães [o] comerão; e o que pertencer a ele e morrer no campo, as aves dos céus [o] comerão."
pt.B: Quem for de Baasa e morrer na cidade será comido pelos cães, e quem for dele e morrer em campo aberto será comido pelas aves do céu."
pt.R: Os cães vão comer quem da família de Baasa morrer na cidade, e as aves vão comer quem morrer no campo."

decisions.choice: eaten by dogs and birds: left unburied, the worst disgrace
decisions.reason: To lie unburied was a curse (Deuteronomy 28:26). The words are the same as those spoken against the house of Jeroboam (14:11), and later against Ahab's house (21:24).

decisions.choice: the field: open country outside the towns
decisions.reason: The field is land away from the city, so the two halves of the verse cover every place where Baasha's family might die.

source.text: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י בַעְשָׁ֛א וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה וּגְבֽוּרָת֑וֹ הֲלֹא־הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of [the] matters of Baasha and what he did and his might, [are] they not written on [the] book of [the] matters of the days of the kings of Israel?

en.L: And the rest of the matters of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Israel?
en.B: The rest of the acts of Baasha, what he did and his might, are written in the Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
en.R: Everything else Baasha did, and his great deeds, is written in the history of the kings of Israel.

es.L: Y el resto de los hechos de Baasa, y lo que hizo, y su poder, ¿no están escritos en el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Israel?
es.B: Los demás hechos de Baasa, lo que hizo y su poder, están escritos en el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Israel.
es.R: Todo lo demás que hizo Baasa, y sus grandes hazañas, está escrito en la historia de los reyes de Israel.

fr.L: Et le reste des actes de Baésha, et ce qu’il a fait, et sa vaillance, n’est-ce pas écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël ?
fr.B: Le reste des actes de Baésha, ce qu’il a fait et sa vaillance, est écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël.
fr.R: Tout ce que Baésha a fait d’autre, et ses exploits, a été écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël.

sw.L: Na mambo mengine ya Baasha, na aliyoyafanya, na nguvu zake, je, hayajaandikwa katika kitabu cha mambo ya siku za wafalme wa Israeli?
sw.B: Mambo mengine ya Baasha, aliyoyafanya na nguvu zake, yameandikwa katika Kitabu cha Historia ya Wafalme wa Israeli.
sw.R: Mambo mengine yote aliyofanya Baasha, na matendo yake makuu, yameandikwa katika historia ya wafalme wa Israeli.

vi.L: Các việc khác của Ba-ê-sa, những điều ông đã làm và sự dũng mãnh của ông, chẳng phải đã được chép trong sách ghi chép các việc thời các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên sao?
vi.B: Các việc khác của Ba-ê-sa, những điều vua đã làm và sự dũng mãnh của vua, đều được chép trong Sách Lịch Sử Các Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Mọi việc khác Ba-ê-sa đã làm, cùng những việc lớn lao của vua, đều được chép trong sách lịch sử các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 바아사의 나머지 일들과 그가 행한 것과 그의 용맹은 이스라엘 왕들의 날들의 일들을 적은 책에 기록되어 있지 않으냐?
ko.B: 바아사의 나머지 행적과 그가 한 일과 그의 업적은 이스라엘 왕 실록에 기록되어 있다.
ko.R: 바아사가 한 다른 모든 일과 그가 이룬 큰일들은 이스라엘 왕들의 역사를 적은 책에 기록되어 있다.

pt.L: E o restante dos atos de Baasa, e o que ele fez, e o seu poder, não estão escritos no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel?
pt.B: Os demais atos de Baasa, o que ele fez e o seu poder, estão escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Israel.
pt.R: Tudo o mais que Baasa fez, e os seus grandes feitos, está escrito na história dos reis de Israel.

decisions.choice: the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Israel: a royal record now lost
decisions.reason: The court record of the kings of Israel, as at 14:19. It has not survived.

decisions.choice: are they not written ...?: a question that means "they are written"
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer yes. It is the standard closing formula for a reign in Kings.

decisions.choice: his might: his strength and deeds of power, especially in war
decisions.reason: The word is used of a king's military strength and achievements. Baasha fought Asa of Judah throughout his reign (15:16-22).

decisions.choice: the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Israel (Literal); the Book of the History of the Kings of Israel (Balanced); the history of the kings of Israel (Readable)
decisions.reason: The source formula has one wording at each level throughout Kings (14:19, 29). Balanced and Readable turn the question into a statement (m2).

source.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב בַּעְשָׁא֙ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּתִרְצָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֵלָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And lay down Baasha with his fathers and was buried in Tirzah, and reigned Elah his son in his place.

en.L: And Baasha lay down with his fathers and was buried in Tirzah, and Elah his son reigned in his place.
en.B: Baasha rested with his ancestors and was buried in Tirzah, and his son Elah became king in his place.
en.R: Baasha died and was buried in Tirzah. His son Elah became king after him.

es.L: Y durmió Baasa con sus padres y fue sepultado en Tirsa, y reinó en su lugar Ela su hijo.
es.B: Baasa descansó con sus antepasados y fue sepultado en Tirsa, y su hijo Ela reinó en su lugar.
es.R: Baasa murió y fue sepultado en Tirsa. Su hijo Ela lo sucedió como rey.

fr.L: Et Baésha se coucha avec ses pères et fut enterré à Tirtsa, et Éla son fils régna à sa place.
fr.B: Baésha reposa avec ses ancêtres et fut enterré à Tirtsa. Et Éla son fils régna à sa place.
fr.R: Baésha est mort et il a été enterré à Tirtsa. Son fils Éla est devenu roi à sa place.

sw.L: Baasha akalala pamoja na baba zake, akazikwa Tirza, na Ela mwanawe akatawala mahali pake.
sw.B: Baasha akapumzika pamoja na babu zake, akazikwa Tirza, na mwanawe Ela akawa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Baasha akafa, akazikwa Tirza. Na mwanawe Ela akawa mfalme mahali pake.

vi.L: Ba-ê-sa nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình và được chôn tại Tiệt-sa; Ê-la con trai ông trị vì thay ông.
vi.B: Ba-ê-sa an giấc cùng tổ tiên và được chôn tại Tiệt-sa. Ê-la con trai vua lên kế vị.
vi.R: Ba-ê-sa qua đời và được chôn tại Tiệt-sa. Ê-la con trai vua lên kế vị.

ko.L: 그리고 바아사가 그의 조상들과 함께 누웠고 디르사에 묻혔다. 그리고 그의 아들 엘라가 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 바아사는 조상들과 함께 잠들었고 디르사에 묻혔다. 그의 아들 엘라가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 바아사는 죽었고 디르사에 묻혔다. 그의 아들 엘라가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.

pt.L: E Baasa descansou com os seus pais e foi sepultado em Tirza, e Elá, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
pt.B: Baasa descansou com os seus antepassados e foi sepultado em Tirza. E o seu filho Elá reinou em seu lugar.
pt.R: Baasa morreu e foi sepultado em Tirza. O seu filho Elá se tornou rei depois dele.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers: died
decisions.reason: This is the formula Kings uses for a king's death (2:10; 14:20, 31). Baasha dies in peace; the judgment spoken against his house falls on his son (verses 11-13).

decisions.choice: Tirzah: the royal city of Israel at this time
decisions.reason: Jeroboam had lived there (14:17), and Baasha reigned from it (15:21, 33). It lay northeast of Shechem. Omri later moved the capital to Samaria (verses 23-24).

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers / rested with his ancestors / died
decisions.reason: The death formula is worded the same way at each level throughout Kings (2:10).

decisions.choice: "Ela"
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish form of Elah, kept through Kings.

decisions.choice: "Éla"
decisions.reason: The usual French spelling, with the accent on the capital.

source.text: וְגַ֡ם בְּיַד־יֵה֨וּא בֶן־חֲנָ֜נִי הַנָּבִ֗יא דְּבַר־יְהוָ֡ה הָיָה֩ אֶל־בַּעְשָׁ֨א וְאֶל־בֵּית֜וֹ וְעַ֥ל כָּל־הָרָעָ֣ה׀אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֣ה׀בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה לְהַכְעִיסוֹ֙ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדָ֔יו לִהְי֖וֹת כְּבֵ֣ית יָרָבְעָ֑ם וְעַ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־הִכָּ֖ה אֹתֽוֹ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And also by [the] hand of Jehu son of Hanani the prophet [the] word of Yahweh came against Baasha and against his house, and because of all the evil which he did in [the] eyes of Yahweh, to provoke him with [the] work of his hands, to be like [the] house of Jeroboam, and because he struck it.

en.L: And also by the hand of Jehu son of Hanani the prophet the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came against Baasha and against his house, both because of all the evil that he did in the eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to provoke {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to anger with the work of his hands, being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he struck it down.
en.B: The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had also come through the prophet Jehu son of Hanani against Baasha and his house. It came because of all the evil Baasha did in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, provoking {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to anger by the work of his hands, so that he became like the house of Jeroboam. It came also because he had struck that house down.
en.R: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke through the prophet Jehu son of Hanani against Baasha and his family. This was because Baasha had done what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil. He made {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} angry by the work of his hands, and he became just like Jeroboam's family. It was also because Baasha had killed Jeroboam's family.

es.L: Y también por medio de Jehú hijo de Hananí, el profeta, vino la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} contra Baasa y contra su casa, tanto por todo el mal que hizo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, provocándolo a ira con la obra de sus manos, siendo como la casa de Jeroboam, como porque la hirió.
es.B: La palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} había venido también por medio del profeta Jehú hijo de Hananí contra Baasa y su casa. Vino por todo el mal que Baasa hizo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, provocándolo a ira con la obra de sus manos, hasta llegar a ser como la casa de Jeroboam. Vino también porque él había destruido aquella casa.
es.R: Así que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} habló por medio del profeta Jehú hijo de Hananí contra Baasa y su familia. Fue porque Baasa había hecho lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba. Hizo enojar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con la obra de sus manos, y llegó a ser igual que la familia de Jeroboam. También fue porque Baasa había matado a la familia de Jeroboam.

fr.L: Et aussi, par la main de Jéhu fils de Hanani, le prophète, la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} vint contre Baésha et contre sa maison, à cause de tout le mal qu’il avait fait aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, en {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}irritant par l’œuvre de ses mains, pour être comme la maison de Jéroboam, et parce qu’il l’avait frappée.
fr.B: La parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} était aussi venue par le prophète Jéhu, fils de Hanani, contre Baésha et sa maison. Elle était venue à cause de tout le mal que Baésha avait fait aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, en {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}irritant par l’œuvre de ses mains, si bien qu’il était devenu semblable à la maison de Jéroboam. Elle était venue aussi parce qu’il avait abattu cette maison.
fr.R: Ainsi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a parlé par le prophète Jéhu, fils de Hanani, contre Baésha et sa famille. C’était parce que Baésha avait fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvais. Il avait mis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en colère par ce qu’il avait fait de ses mains, et il était devenu comme la famille de Jéroboam. C’était aussi parce que Baésha avait tué la famille de Jéroboam.

sw.L: Tena kwa mkono wa Yehu mwana wa Hanani nabii neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lilikuja dhidi ya Baasha na dhidi ya nyumba yake, kwa sababu ya maovu yote aliyoyafanya machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili kumkasirisha kwa kazi ya mikono yake, akiwa kama nyumba ya Yeroboamu, na kwa sababu aliipiga.
sw.B: Neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lilikuwa limekuja pia kupitia nabii Yehu mwana wa Hanani dhidi ya Baasha na nyumba yake. Lilikuja kwa sababu ya maovu yote ambayo Baasha aliyafanya machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akimkasirisha kwa kazi ya mikono yake, hata akawa kama nyumba ya Yeroboamu. Lilikuja pia kwa sababu aliiangamiza nyumba hiyo.
sw.R: Basi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema kupitia nabii Yehu mwana wa Hanani dhidi ya Baasha na jamaa yake. Hii ilikuwa kwa sababu Baasha alikuwa amefanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya. Alimkasirisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa kazi ya mikono yake, akawa sawa kabisa na jamaa ya Yeroboamu. Ilikuwa pia kwa sababu Baasha aliiua jamaa ya Yeroboamu.

vi.L: Lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cũng đã đến qua tay nhà tiên tri Giê-hu con trai Ha-na-ni nghịch cùng Ba-ê-sa và nhà ông, vì mọi điều ác ông đã làm trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bởi việc tay ông làm, trở nên giống như nhà Giê-rô-bô-am, và cũng vì ông đã đánh giết nhà ấy.
vi.B: Lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cũng đã đến qua nhà tiên tri Giê-hu con trai Ha-na-ni nghịch cùng Ba-ê-sa và nhà vua. Lời ấy đến vì mọi điều ác Ba-ê-sa đã làm trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bởi việc tay mình làm, đến nỗi trở nên giống như nhà Giê-rô-bô-am. Lời ấy cũng đến vì vua đã đánh giết nhà ấy.
vi.R: Vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán qua nhà tiên tri Giê-hu con trai Ha-na-ni nghịch cùng Ba-ê-sa và gia đình vua. Đó là vì Ba-ê-sa đã làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác. Vua làm cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi giận bởi việc tay mình làm, và trở nên giống hệt gia đình Giê-rô-bô-am. Đó cũng là vì Ba-ê-sa đã giết cả gia đình Giê-rô-bô-am.

ko.L: 그리고 또한 하나니의 아들 예언자 예후의 손을 통해 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 바아사와 그의 집에 대해 임했다. 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 행한 모든 악 때문이니, 그가 그의 손으로 한 일로 그분을 노엽게 하여 여로보암의 집과 같이 되었기 때문이고, 또 그가 그 집을 쳤기 때문이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀은 하나니의 아들 예언자 예후를 통해서도 바아사와 그의 집안에 임했다. 바아사가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 온갖 악한 일을 하여, 그의 손으로 한 일로 그분을 노엽게 하고 여로보암의 집안처럼 되었기 때문이다. 또 그가 그 집안을 쳐 죽였기 때문이기도 하다.
ko.R: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하나니의 아들 예언자 예후를 통해 바아사와 그의 집안을 치는 말씀을 하셨다. 바아사가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했기 때문이다. 그는 자기 손으로 한 일로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 화나게 했고, 여로보암의 집안과 똑같이 되었다. 또 바아사가 여로보암의 집안을 죽였기 때문이기도 하다.

pt.L: E também pela mão de Jeú, filho de Hanani, o profeta, a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} veio contra Baasa e contra a sua casa, tanto por causa de todo o mal que ele fez aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, provocando-{{deity_pronoun:o|O}} à ira com a obra das suas mãos, sendo como a casa de Jeroboão, como também porque ele a feriu.
pt.B: A palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} também tinha vindo por meio do profeta Jeú, filho de Hanani, contra Baasa e a sua casa. Veio por causa de todo o mal que Baasa fez aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, provocando-{{deity_pronoun:o|O}} à ira com a obra das suas mãos, de modo que se tornou como a casa de Jeroboão. E veio também porque ele tinha destruído aquela casa.
pt.R: Assim {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou por meio do profeta Jeú, filho de Hanani, contra Baasa e a família dele. Foi porque Baasa tinha feito o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava mau. Ele deixou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} irado com a obra das suas mãos e ficou igual à família de Jeroboão. E foi também porque Baasa tinha matado a família de Jeroboão.

decisions.choice: and also: a summary that adds the reasons for the judgment
decisions.reason: The verse sums up verses 1-4 and adds a second reason the prophet's word gave, which verse 2 did not state.

decisions.choice: the work of his hands: his idols, or all his deeds
decisions.reason: The phrase can name idols made by human hands (Deuteronomy 4:28; 31:29), which fits the charge of following Jeroboam's calves. It can also mean what a person does in general. Both readings are possible here.

decisions.choice: because he struck it down: Baasha is guilty for destroying Jeroboam's house
decisions.reason: Baasha killed Nadab and the whole house of Jeroboam (15:27-29). Yahweh had foretold that end (14:10-11), but Baasha acted out of his own ambition, and then did the same sins. A later prophet speaks the same way of Jehu's bloodshed at Jezreel (Hosea 1:4). "It" may also be read "him", meaning Nadab; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: by the hand of: through
decisions.reason: The prophet is the one through whom the word came.

decisions.choice: that house (Balanced); Jeroboam's family (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name what "it" refers to, the house of Jeroboam (m3).

decisions.choice: tinha destruído aquela casa
decisions.reason: Balanced says "destruído" for "struck it down", since Portuguese "ferir uma casa" would not say that the family was wiped out (m3); Literal keeps "feriu", the verb of 15:29.

source.text: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וָשֵׁשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְאָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ אֵלָ֨ה בֶן־בַּעְשָׁ֧א עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּתִרְצָ֖ה שְׁנָתָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: In year twenty and six year of Asa king of Judah reigned Elah son of Baasha over Israel in Tirzah, two years.

en.L: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah son of Baasha reigned over Israel in Tirzah, two years.
en.B: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah son of Baasha became king over Israel in Tirzah, and he reigned two years.
en.R: Elah son of Baasha became king over Israel in the twenty-sixth year that Asa was king of Judah. Elah ruled in Tirzah for two years.

es.L: En el año veintiséis de Asá rey de Judá, Ela hijo de Baasa comenzó a reinar sobre Israel en Tirsa, [y reinó] dos años.
es.B: En el año veintiséis de Asá rey de Judá, Ela hijo de Baasa comenzó a reinar sobre Israel en Tirsa, y reinó dos años.
es.R: Ela hijo de Baasa llegó a ser rey de Israel en el año veintiséis del reinado de Asá en Judá. Ela gobernó en Tirsa durante dos años.

fr.L: En la vingt-sixième année d’Asa, roi de Juda, Éla fils de Baésha régna sur Israël à Tirtsa deux ans.
fr.B: La vingt-sixième année du règne d’Asa, roi de Juda, Éla, fils de Baésha, devint roi d’Israël à Tirtsa ; il régna deux ans.
fr.R: Éla, fils de Baésha, est devenu roi d’Israël pendant la vingt-sixième année du règne d’Asa, roi de Juda. Éla a régné à Tirtsa pendant deux ans.

sw.L: Katika mwaka wa ishirini na sita wa Asa mfalme wa Yuda, Ela mwana wa Baasha akatawala juu ya Israeli huko Tirza, miaka miwili.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa ishirini na sita wa Asa mfalme wa Yuda, Ela mwana wa Baasha alianza kutawala juu ya Israeli huko Tirza, akatawala miaka miwili.
sw.R: Ela mwana wa Baasha alianza kutawala juu ya Israeli katika mwaka wa ishirini na sita wa utawala wa Asa mfalme wa Yuda. Ela alitawala huko Tirza kwa miaka miwili.

vi.L: Vào năm thứ hai mươi sáu đời A-sa vua Giu-đa, Ê-la con trai Ba-ê-sa trị vì trên Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Tiệt-sa, hai năm.
vi.B: Năm thứ hai mươi sáu đời A-sa vua Giu-đa, Ê-la con trai Ba-ê-sa lên làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Tiệt-sa và trị vì hai năm.
vi.R: Ê-la con trai Ba-ê-sa lên làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên vào năm thứ hai mươi sáu A-sa làm vua Giu-đa. Ê-la cai trị tại Tiệt-sa hai năm.

ko.L: 유다 왕 아사 제26년에 바아사의 아들 엘라가 디르사에서 이스라엘 위에 왕이 되어 2년 [동안 다스렸다].
ko.B: 유다 왕 아사가 다스린 지 26년째 되는 해에 바아사의 아들 엘라가 디르사에서 이스라엘의 왕이 되어 2년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.R: 바아사의 아들 엘라는 아사가 유다의 왕이 된 지 26년째 되는 해에 이스라엘의 왕이 되었다. 엘라는 디르사에서 2년 동안 다스렸다.

pt.L: No vigésimo sexto ano de Asa, rei de Judá, Elá, filho de Baasa, reinou sobre Israel em Tirza, dois anos.
pt.B: No vigésimo sexto ano de Asa, rei de Judá, Elá, filho de Baasa, começou a reinar sobre Israel em Tirza, e reinou dois anos.
pt.R: Elá, filho de Baasa, se tornou rei de Israel no vigésimo sexto ano em que Asa era rei de Judá. Elá governou em Tirza durante dois anos.

decisions.choice: two years: counted as parts of years
decisions.reason: Elah began in Asa's twenty-sixth year and died in his twenty-seventh (verse 10). Kings counts any part of a year as a year of a reign, so his "two years" may have been little more than one.

decisions.choice: reigned (Literal); became king ... and he reigned (Balanced); became king ... ruled (Readable)
decisions.reason: The accession formula has one wording at each level throughout Kings. Literal follows the Hebrew; Readable splits it into two sentences.

decisions.choice: Katika mwaka wa N wa X mfalme wa Yuda, Y mwana wa Z alianza kutawala juu ya Israeli huko ..., akatawala miaka N (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The accession formula for the kings of Israel keeps one wording per level through these books, as the terms note sets; Literal says "akatawala", Readable splits it in two.

decisions.choice: Elá, filho de Baasa
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the king's name takes an accent on its last syllable, "Elá", as the valley of 1 Samuel 17:2 is written in Portuguese, so that it is not read as the pronoun "ela".

source.text: וַיִּקְשֹׁ֤ר עָלָיו֙ עַבְדּ֣וֹ זִמְרִ֔י שַׂ֖ר מַחֲצִ֣ית הָרָ֑כֶב וְה֤וּא בְתִרְצָה֙ שֹׁתֶ֣ה שִׁכּ֔וֹר בֵּ֣ית אַרְצָ֔א אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־הַבַּ֖יִת בְּתִרְצָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And conspired against him his servant Zimri, commander of half of the chariotry; and he [was] in Tirzah drinking drunk [in the] house of Arza who [was] over the house in Tirzah.

en.L: And his servant Zimri, commander of half of the chariots, conspired against him. And he [was] in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, who [was] over the house in Tirzah.
en.B: His official Zimri, commander of half the chariots, plotted against him. Elah was in Tirzah at the time, getting drunk in the house of Arza, the steward of the palace in Tirzah.
en.R: Zimri, one of Elah's officials, made plans to kill him. Zimri was the commander of half of Elah's chariots. One day Elah was in Tirzah, getting drunk at the house of Arza, the man in charge of the palace there.

es.L: Y conspiró contra él su siervo Zimri, jefe de la mitad de los carros. Y él [estaba] en Tirsa, bebiendo hasta emborracharse en casa de Arsa, que [estaba] sobre la casa en Tirsa.
es.B: Su oficial Zimri, jefe de la mitad de los carros, conspiró contra él. Ela estaba entonces en Tirsa, emborrachándose en casa de Arsa, el mayordomo del palacio en Tirsa.
es.R: Zimri, uno de los oficiales de Ela, hizo planes para matarlo. Zimri era el jefe de la mitad de los carros de Ela. Un día Ela estaba en Tirsa, emborrachándose en casa de Arsa, el encargado del palacio allí.

fr.L: Et son serviteur Zimri, chef de la moitié des chars, conspira contre lui. Et lui [était] à Tirtsa, buvant jusqu’à s’enivrer dans la maison d’Artsa, qui [était préposé] sur la maison à Tirtsa.
fr.B: Son officier Zimri, chef de la moitié des chars, complota contre lui. Éla était alors à Tirtsa, en train de s’enivrer dans la maison d’Artsa, le chef du palais à Tirtsa.
fr.R: Zimri, l’un des officiers d’Éla, a décidé de le tuer. Zimri commandait la moitié des chars d’Éla. Un jour, Éla était à Tirtsa et il s’enivrait chez Artsa, l’homme chargé du palais.

sw.L: Mtumishi wake Zimri, jemadari wa nusu ya magari ya vita, akafanya fitina juu yake. Naye [alikuwa] Tirza, akinywa hata kulewa nyumbani mwa Arza, aliyekuwa [msimamizi] juu ya nyumba huko Tirza.
sw.B: Afisa wake Zimri, mkuu wa nusu ya magari ya vita, alipanga njama dhidi yake. Wakati huo Ela alikuwa Tirza, akilewa nyumbani mwa Arza, msimamizi wa ikulu huko Tirza.
sw.R: Zimri, mmoja wa maafisa wa Ela, alipanga mpango wa kumuua. Zimri alikuwa mkuu wa nusu ya magari ya vita ya Ela. Siku moja Ela alikuwa Tirza, akilewa nyumbani mwa Arza, mtu aliyesimamia ikulu huko.

vi.L: Đầy tớ ông là Xim-ri, chỉ huy phân nửa số xe chiến mã, mưu phản ông. Bấy giờ ông đang ở Tiệt-sa, uống say sưa trong nhà Ạt-sa, quan cai quản cung điện tại Tiệt-sa.
vi.B: Xim-ri, một triều thần của vua, chỉ huy phân nửa số xe chiến mã, mưu phản vua. Lúc ấy Ê-la đang ở Tiệt-sa, uống say sưa trong nhà Ạt-sa, quan cai quản cung điện tại Tiệt-sa.
vi.R: Xim-ri, một quan chức của Ê-la, âm mưu giết vua. Xim-ri là người chỉ huy phân nửa số xe chiến mã của Ê-la. Một hôm Ê-la đang ở Tiệt-sa, uống say sưa tại nhà Ạt-sa, người cai quản cung điện ở đó.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 신하, 곧 병거 절반을 지휘하는 시므리가 그를 반역했다. 그때 그는 디르사에서 디르사 궁의 궁내 대신 아르사의 집에서 마시고 취해 있었다.
ko.B: 병거 부대의 절반을 지휘하는 그의 신하 시므리가 그에게 반역할 음모를 꾸몄다. 그때 엘라는 디르사에 있었는데, 디르사 궁내 대신 아르사의 집에서 술을 마시고 취해 있었다.
ko.R: 엘라의 신하 가운데 시므리라는 사람이 엘라를 죽이려고 음모를 꾸몄다. 시므리는 엘라의 병거 절반을 지휘하는 사람이었다. 어느 날 엘라는 디르사에서 그곳 왕궁을 맡아 관리하는 아르사의 집에 가서 술에 취해 있었다.

pt.L: E o seu escravo Zinri, chefe da metade dos carros, conspirou contra ele. E ele [estava] em Tirza, bebendo [até ficar] bêbado na casa de Arsa, que [estava] sobre a casa em Tirza.
pt.B: O seu oficial Zinri, comandante da metade dos carros de guerra, conspirou contra ele. Naquele tempo Elá estava em Tirza, embriagando-se na casa de Arsa, o administrador do palácio em Tirza.
pt.R: Zinri, um dos oficiais de Elá, fez planos para matá-lo. Zinri era o comandante da metade dos carros de guerra de Elá. Um dia, Elá estava em Tirza, ficando bêbado na casa de Arsa, o homem que cuidava do palácio ali.

decisions.choice: his servant: a royal officer
decisions.reason: Zimri was one of the king's own officers, a high one, commanding half of the chariot force. The word marks his duty to the king he betrayed.

decisions.choice: over the house: the steward who ran the royal household
decisions.reason: "Over the house" is a title for the official in charge of the palace and its affairs (4:6; 18:3; Isaiah 22:15). The king was drinking in his steward's own house.

decisions.choice: drinking drunk: drinking until he was drunk
decisions.reason: The two words together stress that Elah was helpless with drink while his army was at war (verse 15).

decisions.choice: his official (Balanced); one of Elah's officials (Readable)
decisions.reason: As with "the king's servants" in Samuel and Kings, Literal keeps "servant" and Balanced and Readable say "official" for a king's officer.

decisions.choice: made plans to kill him
decisions.reason: Readable explains "conspired" by what the plot was for (verse 10).

decisions.choice: "que [estaba] sobre la casa" (L); "el mayordomo del palacio" (B); "el encargado del palacio" (R)
decisions.reason: The office as the Kings and Chronicles terms table sets for "over the household"; Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase.

decisions.choice: "Zimri"; "Arsa"
decisions.reason: Zimri as the terms table sets; Arsa is the usual Spanish form of Arza.

decisions.choice: "le chef du palais" (B)
decisions.reason: The title "over the house" as the Kings and Chronicles terms note gives it, for the whole block; Literal keeps the Hebrew wording, Readable describes it.

decisions.choice: [msimamizi] juu ya nyumba (Literal); msimamizi wa ikulu (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The palace steward is "msimamizi wa ikulu", as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "xe chiến mã"; "quan cai quản cung điện"
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for chariots and for the official over the royal household, used through this block.

decisions.choice: names: "Xim-ri", "Ạt-sa"
decisions.reason: Zimri as the terms note; Arza in the usual Protestant form.

decisions.choice: "궁내 대신" for the one "over the house"
decisions.reason: The terms note's title for the steward of the royal household; Readable describes the office.

decisions.choice: Zinri; o seu escravo (L), o seu oficial (B, R); Arsa ... sobre a casa (L), o administrador do palácio (B)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "Zinri" as the shared list for Kings has it. The king's officer is "escravo" at Literal and "oficial" at Balanced and Readable, as the English. The palace title (m2) keeps its Hebrew picture at Literal and is "administrador do palácio" at Balanced, the plain title of the official over a household, as 4:6 is read.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֤א זִמְרִי֙ וַיַּכֵּ֣הוּ וַיְמִיתֵ֔הוּ בִּשְׁנַת֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וָשֶׁ֔בַע לְאָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֖ךְ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And came Zimri and struck him and killed him in year twenty and seven of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.

en.L: And Zimri came in and struck him and killed him, in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and he reigned in his place.
en.B: Zimri came in and struck him down, killing him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and he became king in his place.
en.R: Zimri came in, attacked Elah and killed him. This was in the twenty-seventh year that Asa was king of Judah. Then Zimri became king in Elah's place.

es.L: Y entró Zimri y lo hirió y lo mató, en el año veintisiete de Asá rey de Judá, y reinó en su lugar.
es.B: Zimri entró, lo hirió y lo mató en el año veintisiete de Asá rey de Judá, y reinó en su lugar.
es.R: Zimri entró, atacó a Ela y lo mató. Esto fue en el año veintisiete del reinado de Asá en Judá. Luego Zimri llegó a ser rey en lugar de Ela.

fr.L: Et Zimri entra, le frappa et le tua, en la vingt-septième année d’Asa, roi de Juda, et il régna à sa place.
fr.B: Zimri entra, le frappa et le tua, la vingt-septième année du règne d’Asa, roi de Juda, et il régna à sa place.
fr.R: Zimri est entré, il a attaqué Éla et il l’a tué. C’était pendant la vingt-septième année du règne d’Asa, roi de Juda. Ensuite Zimri est devenu roi à la place d’Éla.

sw.L: Zimri akaingia akampiga akamuua, katika mwaka wa ishirini na saba wa Asa mfalme wa Yuda, akatawala mahali pake.
sw.B: Zimri akaingia akampiga, akamuua katika mwaka wa ishirini na saba wa Asa mfalme wa Yuda, akawa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Zimri akaingia, akamshambulia Ela na kumuua. Hii ilikuwa katika mwaka wa ishirini na saba wa utawala wa Asa mfalme wa Yuda. Kisha Zimri akawa mfalme mahali pa Ela.

vi.L: Xim-ri vào đánh ông và giết ông vào năm thứ hai mươi bảy đời A-sa vua Giu-đa, rồi trị vì thay ông.
vi.B: Xim-ri xông vào đánh giết vua vào năm thứ hai mươi bảy đời A-sa vua Giu-đa, rồi lên làm vua thay Ê-la.
vi.R: Xim-ri xông vào tấn công và giết chết Ê-la. Việc ấy xảy ra vào năm thứ hai mươi bảy A-sa làm vua Giu-đa. Rồi Xim-ri lên làm vua thay Ê-la.

ko.L: 그리고 시므리가 들어와서 유다 왕 아사 제27년에 그를 쳐 죽이고, 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 시므리가 들어와 그를 쳐 죽였다. 유다 왕 아사가 다스린 지 27년째 되는 해였다. 시므리가 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 시므리가 들어와 엘라를 공격하여 죽였다. 그때는 아사가 유다의 왕이 된 지 27년째 되는 해였다. 그리고 시므리가 엘라 대신 왕이 되었다.

pt.L: E Zinri entrou, e o feriu e o matou, no vigésimo sétimo ano de Asa, rei de Judá, e reinou em seu lugar.
pt.B: Zinri entrou e o feriu, matando-o no vigésimo sétimo ano de Asa, rei de Judá, e passou a reinar em seu lugar.
pt.R: Zinri entrou, atacou Elá e o matou. Isso foi no vigésimo sétimo ano em que Asa era rei de Judá. Depois Zinri se tornou rei no lugar de Elá.

decisions.choice: struck him and killed him: attacked him and put him to death
decisions.reason: The first verb is the blow, the second its result. The same pair is used of Baasha's killing of Nadab (15:27-28).

decisions.choice: reigned in his place: the third change of dynasty by violence
decisions.reason: Baasha had taken the throne from Jeroboam's son by murder (15:28); now Zimri takes it from Baasha's son the same way.

source.text: וַיְהִ֨י בְמָלְכ֜וֹ כְּשִׁבְתּ֣וֹ עַל־כִּסְא֗וֹ הִכָּה֙ אֶת־כָּל־בֵּ֣ית בַּעְשָׁ֔א לֹֽא־הִשְׁאִ֥יר ל֖וֹ מַשְׁתִּ֣ין בְּקִ֑יר וְגֹאֲלָ֖יו וְרֵעֵֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when he reigned, when he sat on his throne, he struck all [the] house of Baasha; not he left to him one urinating against a wall, and his redeemers, and his friend.

en.L: And it happened, when he became king, as soon as he sat on his throne, he struck down all the house of Baasha; he did not leave him one who urinates against a wall, neither his redeemers nor his friend.
en.B: As soon as he became king and sat on his throne, he struck down the whole house of Baasha. He did not leave him a single male, neither his family redeemers nor his friends.
en.R: As soon as Zimri became king, he killed Baasha's whole family. He did not leave a single man or boy alive, not even the relatives who could avenge them, or their friends.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando comenzó a reinar, en cuanto se sentó en su trono, hirió a toda la casa de Baasa; no le dejó ni uno que orinara contra la pared, ni sus redentores ni su amigo.
es.B: En cuanto llegó a ser rey y se sentó en su trono, mató a toda la casa de Baasa. No le dejó ni un solo varón, ni a sus parientes redentores ni a sus amigos.
es.R: En cuanto Zimri llegó a ser rey, mató a toda la familia de Baasa. No dejó vivo ni a un solo hombre o niño, ni siquiera a los parientes que podían vengarlos, ni a sus amigos.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand il devint roi, dès qu’il fut assis sur son trône, qu’il frappa toute la maison de Baésha ; il ne lui laissa pas un seul qui urine contre un mur, ni ses rédempteurs ni son ami.
fr.B: Dès qu’il fut roi et assis sur son trône, il abattit toute la maison de Baésha. Il ne lui laissa pas un seul homme, ni parmi ses proches chargés de le défendre ni parmi ses amis.
fr.R: Dès que Zimri est devenu roi, il a tué toute la famille de Baésha. Il n’a laissé en vie aucun homme ni aucun garçon, pas même les parents qui auraient pu les venger, ni leurs amis.

sw.L: Ikawa, alipoanza kutawala, mara alipoketi juu ya kiti chake cha enzi, akaipiga nyumba yote ya Baasha; hakumwachia akojoaye ukutani hata mmoja, wala wakombozi wake, wala rafiki yake.
sw.B: Mara tu alipokuwa mfalme na kuketi juu ya kiti chake cha enzi, aliiua nyumba yote ya Baasha. Hakumwachia hata mwanamume mmoja, wala ndugu wa karibu waliopaswa kulipiza kisasi, wala rafiki zake.
sw.R: Mara tu Zimri alipokuwa mfalme, aliiua jamaa yote ya Baasha. Hakumwacha hai hata mwanamume mmoja au mvulana, hata ndugu waliokuwa na wajibu wa kulipiza kisasi, wala rafiki zao.

vi.L: Xảy ra, khi ông lên làm vua, vừa khi ngồi trên ngai mình, ông đánh giết cả nhà Ba-ê-sa; ông không để lại cho nhà ấy một kẻ đái vào tường nào, cả những người bà con có quyền chuộc lẫn bạn hữu của nó.
vi.B: Vừa lên làm vua và ngồi trên ngai, Xim-ri giết sạch cả nhà Ba-ê-sa. Vua không để sót một người nam nào, dù là bà con có bổn phận báo thù hay bạn hữu của nhà ấy.
vi.R: Vừa lên làm vua, Xim-ri giết hết mọi người trong gia đình Ba-ê-sa. Vua không để sót một người nam nào, kể cả những bà con có thể báo thù cho họ, hay bạn bè của họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 왕이 되어 그의 왕좌에 앉자마자 바아사의 온 집을 쳤다. 그는 그에게 벽에 소변을 보는 자를 하나도 남기지 않았고, 그의 기업 무를 자들과 그의 친구도 [남기지 않았다].
ko.B: 그는 왕이 되어 왕좌에 앉자마자 바아사의 온 집안을 쳐 죽였다. 그는 바아사에게 남자를 하나도 남기지 않았고, 그의 집안을 지킬 친족들과 그의 친구들도 남기지 않았다.
ko.R: 시므리는 왕이 되자마자 바아사의 온 집안을 죽였다. 그는 남자는 어른이든 아이든 하나도 살려 두지 않았다. 원수를 갚아 줄 수 있는 친척들도, 친구들도 살려 두지 않았다.

pt.L: E aconteceu que, quando começou a reinar, logo que se sentou no seu trono, ele feriu toda a casa de Baasa; não lhe deixou [nem] um que urina na parede, nem os seus resgatadores, nem o seu amigo.
pt.B: Assim que começou a reinar e se sentou no trono, ele matou toda a família de Baasa. Não lhe deixou um único homem, nem os seus parentes resgatadores, nem os seus amigos.
pt.R: Assim que Zinri se tornou rei, ele matou toda a família de Baasa. Não deixou vivo nenhum homem ou menino, nem mesmo os parentes que poderiam vingá-los, nem os amigos deles.

decisions.choice: one who urinates against a wall: any male at all
decisions.reason: A coarse expression for every male, used in curses on a royal house (14:10; 21:21; 2 Kings 9:8) and by David in anger (1 Samuel 25:22, 34). It means none would be left to carry on the family line.

decisions.choice: his redeemers: the near relatives bound to defend and avenge the family
decisions.reason: The *go'el* was the close relative who bought back family land and avenged a killed kinsman (Leviticus 25:25; Numbers 35:19). Zimri left no one who might avenge Baasha's house or claim its throne.

decisions.choice: his friend: his supporters and close companions
decisions.reason: The singular "friend" stands for the whole group of the king's friends. "Friend" can also be a court title (4:5), so it may mean his trusted advisers.

decisions.choice: a single male (Balanced); a single man or boy (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the coarse expression (m1). Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: the relatives who could avenge them
decisions.reason: Readable explains the duty of the redeemer that matters here (m2).

decisions.choice: "sus redentores" (L); "sus parientes redentores" (B); "los parientes que podían vengarlos" (R)
decisions.reason: The *goʾel* is the near kinsman bound to defend and avenge the family; Balanced uses the established Spanish term and Readable explains his role, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "ses rédempteurs" (L); "ses proches chargés de le défendre" (B)
decisions.reason: The *go’el* was the near relative who redeemed and defended the family; Literal keeps the traditional "rédempteur", Balanced and Readable say what the role was.

decisions.choice: ndugu wa karibu waliopaswa kulipiza kisasi
decisions.reason: The "redeemers" are the near kinsmen bound to defend and avenge the family; Literal keeps "wakombozi", Balanced and Readable say who they were.

decisions.choice: "người bà con có quyền chuộc" (L); "bà con có bổn phận báo thù" (B); "bà con có thể báo thù" (R)
decisions.reason: The redeemer was the near kinsman bound to defend and avenge the family; Literal keeps the idea of redeeming, Balanced and Readable say what mattered here.

decisions.choice: "기업 무를 자들" (L), "집안을 지킬 친족들" (B), "원수를 갚아 줄 수 있는 친척들" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the traditional Korean term for the *goʾel*; "구속자" would sound like the theological Redeemer. Balanced and Readable say what these relatives did.

decisions.choice: um que urina na parede (L), um único homem (B), nenhum homem ou menino (R); os seus resgatadores (L), os seus parentes resgatadores (B), os parentes que poderiam vingá-los (R)
decisions.reason: The coarse phrase is worded as at 14:10 at each level, with no gender setting (m1). The go'el (m2) is "resgatador", the word Leviticus 25:25 and Ruth set in Portuguese for the near relative; Readable names the duty that matters here, avenging the family, as the English does.

source.text: וַיַּשְׁמֵ֣ד זִמְרִ֔י אֵ֖ת כָּל־בֵּ֣ית בַּעְשָׁ֑א כִּדְבַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר אֶל־בַּעְשָׁ֔א בְּיַ֖ד יֵה֥וּא הַנָּבִֽיא׃

records.literal_gloss: And destroyed Zimri all [the] house of Baasha, according to [the] word of Yahweh which he spoke against Baasha by [the] hand of Jehu the prophet,

en.L: And Zimri destroyed all the house of Baasha, according to the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke against Baasha by the hand of Jehu the prophet,
en.B: So Zimri destroyed the whole house of Baasha, as the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said against Baasha through Jehu the prophet,
en.R: So Zimri wiped out Baasha's whole family, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had warned Baasha through the prophet Jehu.

es.L: Y Zimri destruyó toda la casa de Baasa, conforme a la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} habló contra Baasa por medio de Jehú el profeta,
es.B: Así Zimri destruyó a toda la casa de Baasa, como la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} lo había dicho contra Baasa por medio del profeta Jehú,
es.R: Así Zimri acabó con toda la familia de Baasa, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se lo había advertido a Baasa por medio del profeta Jehú.

fr.L: Et Zimri extermina toute la maison de Baésha, selon la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait dite contre Baésha par la main de Jéhu le prophète,
fr.B: Zimri extermina donc toute la maison de Baésha, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait annoncé contre Baésha par le prophète Jéhu,
fr.R: Zimri a donc anéanti toute la famille de Baésha, exactement comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait annoncé à Baésha par le prophète Jéhu.

sw.L: Zimri akaiangamiza nyumba yote ya Baasha, sawasawa na neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilolinena dhidi ya Baasha kwa mkono wa Yehu nabii,
sw.B: Basi Zimri akaiangamiza nyumba yote ya Baasha, kama neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lilivyosema dhidi ya Baasha kupitia Yehu nabii,
sw.R: Basi Zimri akaiangamiza jamaa yote ya Baasha, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwonya Baasha kupitia nabii Yehu.

vi.L: Xim-ri tiêu diệt cả nhà Ba-ê-sa, đúng theo lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán nghịch cùng Ba-ê-sa qua tay nhà tiên tri Giê-hu,
vi.B: Vậy Xim-ri tiêu diệt cả nhà Ba-ê-sa, đúng như lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán nghịch cùng Ba-ê-sa qua nhà tiên tri Giê-hu,
vi.R: Vậy Xim-ri diệt sạch cả gia đình Ba-ê-sa, đúng như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã cảnh cáo Ba-ê-sa qua nhà tiên tri Giê-hu.

ko.L: 그리고 시므리가 바아사의 온 집을 멸망시켰다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀, 곧 그분께서 예언자 예후의 손을 통해 바아사에 대해 하신 말씀대로였다.
ko.B: 이렇게 시므리는 바아사의 온 집안을 멸망시켰다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예언자 예후를 통해 바아사에게 하신 말씀대로였다.
ko.R: 이렇게 시므리는 바아사의 온 집안을 없애 버렸다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예언자 예후를 통해 바아사에게 경고하신 그대로였다.

pt.L: E Zinri destruiu toda a casa de Baasa, segundo a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} falou contra Baasa pela mão de Jeú, o profeta,
pt.B: Assim Zinri destruiu toda a família de Baasa, conforme {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha dito contra Baasa por meio do profeta Jeú,
pt.R: Assim Zinri acabou com toda a família de Baasa, exatamente como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha avisado Baasa por meio do profeta Jeú.

decisions.choice: according to the word of Yahweh: the prophecy of verses 1-4 is fulfilled
decisions.reason: Kings often notes that a prophet's word came true (15:29; 2 Kings 10:17). Zimri's crime is the means by which Yahweh's word is carried out, yet it is still his own crime (compare verse 7).

decisions.choice: destroyed: wiped out completely
decisions.reason: The verb means to exterminate, to destroy so that nothing remains.

source.text: אֶ֚ל כָּל־חַטֹּ֣אות בַּעְשָׁ֔א וְחַטֹּ֖אות אֵלָ֣ה בְנ֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטְא֗וּ וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶחֱטִ֨יאוּ֙ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְהַכְעִ֗יס אֶת־יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּהַבְלֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: because of all [the] sins of Baasha and [the] sins of Elah his son, which they sinned and which they made sin Israel, to provoke Yahweh God of Israel with their vanities.

en.L: because of all the sins of Baasha and the sins of Elah his son, which they sinned and which they made Israel sin, to provoke {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of Israel to anger with their worthless idols.
en.B: because of all the sins of Baasha and the sins of his son Elah, the sins they committed and by which they led Israel to sin, provoking {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, to anger with their worthless idols.
en.R: This happened because of all the sins of Baasha and his son Elah. They sinned, and they led Israel into sin. They made {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, angry with their useless idols.

es.L: a causa de todos los pecados de Baasa y los pecados de Ela su hijo, con que pecaron y con que hicieron pecar a Israel, provocando a ira {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, con sus ídolos vanos.
es.B: a causa de todos los pecados de Baasa y los de su hijo Ela, los pecados que cometieron y que hicieron cometer a Israel, provocando a ira {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, con sus ídolos vanos.
es.R: Esto sucedió a causa de todos los pecados de Baasa y de su hijo Ela. Ellos pecaron e hicieron pecar a Israel. Hicieron enojar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, con sus ídolos inútiles.

fr.L: à cause de tous les péchés de Baésha et des péchés d’Éla son fils, qu’ils avaient commis et qu’ils avaient fait commettre à Israël, en irritant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, par leurs vaines idoles.
fr.B: à cause de tous les péchés de Baésha et de son fils Éla, les péchés qu’ils avaient commis et qu’ils avaient fait commettre à Israël, en irritant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, par leurs vaines idoles.
fr.R: C’est arrivé à cause de tous les péchés de Baésha et de son fils Éla. Ils ont péché et ils ont entraîné Israël dans le péché. Ils ont mis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, en colère avec leurs idoles inutiles.

sw.L: kwa sababu ya dhambi zote za Baasha na dhambi za Ela mwanawe, walizotenda na walizowafanya Israeli kutenda, ili kumkasirisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa Israeli kwa sanamu zao zisizofaa kitu.
sw.B: kwa sababu ya dhambi zote za Baasha na dhambi za mwanawe Ela, dhambi walizotenda na ambazo kwa hizo waliwaongoza Israeli kutenda dhambi, wakimkasirisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, kwa sanamu zao zisizofaa kitu.
sw.R: Hili lilitokea kwa sababu ya dhambi zote za Baasha na mwanawe Ela. Walitenda dhambi, wakawaongoza Israeli kutenda dhambi. Walimkasirisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, kwa sanamu zao zisizo na faida.

vi.L: vì mọi tội của Ba-ê-sa và các tội của Ê-la con trai ông, là tội họ đã phạm và đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm, để chọc giận {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, bởi các thần tượng hư không của họ.
vi.B: vì mọi tội của Ba-ê-sa và của Ê-la con trai vua, là tội họ đã phạm và đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm, chọc giận {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, bởi các thần tượng hư không của họ.
vi.R: Việc ấy xảy ra vì mọi tội của Ba-ê-sa và Ê-la con trai vua. Họ đã phạm tội và khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm tội. Họ làm cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, nổi giận vì các thần tượng vô dụng của họ.

ko.L: 바아사의 모든 죄와 그의 아들 엘라의 죄, 곧 그들이 지은 죄와 그들이 이스라엘에게 짓게 한 죄 때문이요, 그들이 헛된 우상들로 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 노엽게 했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그것은 바아사의 모든 죄와 그의 아들 엘라의 죄 때문이었다. 그들은 스스로 죄를 짓고 이스라엘에게도 죄를 짓게 했으며, 헛된 우상들로 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 노엽게 했다.
ko.R: 이 일은 바아사와 그의 아들 엘라가 지은 모든 죄 때문에 일어났다. 그들은 자기들도 죄를 짓고 이스라엘도 죄를 짓게 했다. 그들은 쓸모없는 우상들로 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 화나게 했다.

pt.L: por causa de todos os pecados de Baasa e dos pecados de Elá, seu filho, que eles pecaram e com os quais fizeram Israel pecar, provocando à ira {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, com os seus ídolos inúteis.
pt.B: por causa de todos os pecados de Baasa e do seu filho Elá, os pecados que eles cometeram e com os quais fizeram Israel pecar, provocando à ira {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, com os seus ídolos inúteis.
pt.R: Isso aconteceu por causa de todos os pecados de Baasa e do seu filho Elá. Eles pecaram e levaram Israel a pecar também. Eles deixaram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, irado com os seus ídolos sem valor.

decisions.choice: their vanities: their worthless idols
decisions.reason: The word *hevel* means a breath or vapor, something empty and passing. Used of gods it calls idols nothing, powerless and useless (Deuteronomy 32:21; Jeremiah 8:19; 10:15). Here it names the gods and images Israel worshiped, including Jeroboam's calves.

decisions.choice: because of all the sins: the judgment falls for what Baasha and Elah did
decisions.reason: The writer gives the reason for the end of Baasha's house: the sins of the two kings and the sin they led Israel into (verse 2).

decisions.choice: worthless idols (Literal, Balanced); useless idols (Readable)
decisions.reason: The same wording as Deuteronomy 32:21, kept at each level wherever Kings uses this word for idols (verse 26).

decisions.choice: made Israel sin / led Israel to sin / led Israel into sin; provoke to anger / made angry
decisions.reason: As in verse 2.

decisions.choice: "ídolos vanos" (L, B); "ídolos inútiles" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means breath or emptiness, said of idols; each level follows the English choice.

decisions.choice: "vaines idoles" (L, B); "idoles inutiles" (R)
decisions.reason: *hevel* is a breath, something empty; French says it of idols with "vaines" and at Readable "inutiles", as the English "worthless" and "useless". For the whole block.

decisions.choice: sanamu zisizofaa kitu (Literal, Balanced); sanamu zisizo na faida (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "vanities" means worthless idols; Swahili names them "sanamu" and says they are worthless, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "thần tượng hư không" (L, B); "thần tượng vô dụng" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew calls the idols "vanities", empty breath; "hư không" keeps that sense, Readable says plainly that they are useless.

decisions.choice: os seus ídolos inúteis (L, B); os seus ídolos sem valor (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also verse 26): the word for a breath or vapour used of idols (m1) is "ídolos inúteis" at Literal and Balanced and "ídolos sem valor" at Readable, as the English; the older "vaidades" now reads as pride in one's looks.

source.text: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י אֵלָ֖ה וְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֽוֹא־הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of [the] matters of Elah and all that he did, [are] they not written on [the] book of [the] matters of the days of the kings of Israel?

en.L: And the rest of the matters of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Israel?
en.B: The rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are written in the Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
en.R: Everything else Elah did is written in the history of the kings of Israel.

es.L: Y el resto de los hechos de Ela y todo lo que hizo, ¿no están escritos en el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Israel?
es.B: Los demás hechos de Ela y todo lo que hizo están escritos en el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Israel.
es.R: Todo lo demás que hizo Ela está escrito en la historia de los reyes de Israel.

fr.L: Et le reste des actes d’Éla et tout ce qu’il a fait, n’est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël ?
fr.B: Le reste des actes d’Éla et tout ce qu’il a fait est écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël.
fr.R: Tout ce qu’Éla a fait d’autre a été écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël.

sw.L: Na mambo mengine ya Ela, na yote aliyoyafanya, je, hayajaandikwa katika kitabu cha mambo ya siku za wafalme wa Israeli?
sw.B: Mambo mengine ya Ela, na yote aliyoyafanya, yameandikwa katika Kitabu cha Historia ya Wafalme wa Israeli.
sw.R: Mambo mengine yote aliyofanya Ela yameandikwa katika historia ya wafalme wa Israeli.

vi.L: Các việc khác của Ê-la và mọi điều ông đã làm, chẳng phải đã được chép trong sách ghi chép các việc thời các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên sao?
vi.B: Các việc khác của Ê-la và mọi điều vua đã làm đều được chép trong Sách Lịch Sử Các Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Mọi việc khác Ê-la đã làm đều được chép trong sách lịch sử các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 엘라의 나머지 일들과 그가 행한 모든 것은 이스라엘 왕들의 날들의 일들을 적은 책에 기록되어 있지 않으냐?
ko.B: 엘라의 나머지 행적과 그가 한 모든 일은 이스라엘 왕 실록에 기록되어 있다.
ko.R: 엘라가 한 다른 모든 일은 이스라엘 왕들의 역사를 적은 책에 기록되어 있다.

pt.L: E o restante dos atos de Elá e tudo o que ele fez, não estão escritos no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel?
pt.B: Os demais atos de Elá e tudo o que ele fez estão escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Israel.
pt.R: Tudo o mais que Elá fez está escrito na história dos reis de Israel.

decisions.choice: the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Israel: the royal record named in verse 5
decisions.reason: As in verse 5. The death and burial formula is missing for Elah, who was murdered (verse 10).

decisions.choice: the source formula
decisions.reason: As in verse 5.

source.text: בִּשְׁנַת֩ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וָשֶׁ֜בַע שָׁנָ֗ה לְאָסָא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה מָלַ֥ךְ זִמְרִ֛י שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים בְּתִרְצָ֑ה וְהָעָ֣ם חֹנִ֔ים עַֽל־גִּבְּת֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַפְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: In year twenty and seven year of Asa king of Judah reigned Zimri seven days in Tirzah; and the people [were] encamping against Gibbethon, which [belonged] to the Philistines.

en.L: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. And the people [were] encamped against Gibbethon, which [belonged] to the Philistines.
en.B: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri became king in Tirzah, and he reigned seven days. The troops were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.
en.R: Zimri became king in the twenty-seventh year that Asa was king of Judah. He ruled in Tirzah for only seven days. At that time the army was camped near Gibbethon, a town that belonged to the Philistines, ready to attack it.

es.L: En el año veintisiete de Asá rey de Judá, reinó Zimri siete días en Tirsa. Y el pueblo [estaba] acampado contra Gibetón, que [pertenecía] a los filisteos.
es.B: En el año veintisiete de Asá rey de Judá, Zimri comenzó a reinar en Tirsa, y reinó siete días. Las tropas estaban acampadas frente a Gibetón, que pertenecía a los filisteos.
es.R: Zimri llegó a ser rey en el año veintisiete del reinado de Asá en Judá. Gobernó en Tirsa solamente siete días. En ese tiempo el ejército estaba acampado cerca de Gibetón, una ciudad que pertenecía a los filisteos, listo para atacarla.

fr.L: En la vingt-septième année d’Asa, roi de Juda, Zimri régna sept jours à Tirtsa. Et le peuple [était] campé contre Guibbethôn, qui [appartenait] aux Philistins.
fr.B: La vingt-septième année du règne d’Asa, roi de Juda, Zimri devint roi à Tirtsa ; il régna sept jours. Les troupes étaient campées devant Guibbethôn, qui appartenait aux Philistins.
fr.R: Zimri est devenu roi pendant la vingt-septième année du règne d’Asa, roi de Juda. Il a régné à Tirtsa pendant sept jours seulement. À ce moment-là, l’armée campait près de Guibbethôn, une ville qui appartenait aux Philistins, prête à l’attaquer.

sw.L: Katika mwaka wa ishirini na saba wa Asa mfalme wa Yuda, Zimri akatawala siku saba huko Tirza. Na watu [walikuwa] wamepiga kambi dhidi ya Gibethoni, uliokuwa [mji] wa Wafilisti.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa ishirini na saba wa Asa mfalme wa Yuda, Zimri alianza kutawala huko Tirza, akatawala siku saba. Askari walikuwa wamepiga kambi kuuzingira Gibethoni, mji wa Wafilisti.
sw.R: Zimri alianza kutawala katika mwaka wa ishirini na saba wa utawala wa Asa mfalme wa Yuda. Alitawala huko Tirza kwa siku saba tu. Wakati huo jeshi lilikuwa limepiga kambi karibu na Gibethoni, mji wa Wafilisti, tayari kuushambulia.

vi.L: Vào năm thứ hai mươi bảy đời A-sa vua Giu-đa, Xim-ri trị vì bảy ngày tại Tiệt-sa. Bấy giờ dân chúng đang đóng trại vây Ghi-bê-thôn, [thành] thuộc người Phi-li-tin.
vi.B: Năm thứ hai mươi bảy đời A-sa vua Giu-đa, Xim-ri lên làm vua tại Tiệt-sa và trị vì bảy ngày. Bấy giờ quân lính đang đóng trại vây Ghi-bê-thôn, thành thuộc người Phi-li-tin.
vi.R: Xim-ri lên làm vua vào năm thứ hai mươi bảy A-sa làm vua Giu-đa. Ông chỉ cai trị tại Tiệt-sa được bảy ngày. Lúc ấy quân đội Y-sơ-ra-ên đang đóng trại gần Ghi-bê-thôn, một thành của người Phi-li-tin, sẵn sàng tấn công.

ko.L: 유다 왕 아사 제27년에 시므리가 디르사에서 7일 동안 왕이 되었다. 그때 백성은 블레셋 사람들에게 속한 깁브돈을 향해 진을 치고 있었다.
ko.B: 유다 왕 아사가 다스린 지 27년째 되는 해에 시므리가 디르사에서 왕이 되어 7일 동안 다스렸다. 그때 군대는 블레셋 사람들의 성읍 깁브돈을 향해 진을 치고 있었다.
ko.R: 시므리는 아사가 유다의 왕이 된 지 27년째 되는 해에 왕이 되었다. 그는 디르사에서 겨우 7일 동안 다스렸다. 그때 이스라엘 군대는 블레셋 사람들의 성읍 깁브돈 근처에 진을 치고 그곳을 치려고 하고 있었다.

pt.L: No vigésimo sétimo ano de Asa, rei de Judá, Zinri reinou sete dias em Tirza. E o povo [estava] acampado contra Gibetom, que [pertencia] aos filisteus.
pt.B: No vigésimo sétimo ano de Asa, rei de Judá, Zinri começou a reinar em Tirza, e reinou sete dias. As tropas estavam acampadas diante de Gibetom, que pertencia aos filisteus.
pt.R: Zinri se tornou rei no vigésimo sétimo ano em que Asa era rei de Judá. Ele governou em Tirza durante apenas sete dias. Naquele tempo, o exército estava acampado perto de Gibetom, uma cidade que pertencia aos filisteus, pronto para atacá-la.

decisions.choice: the people: the army in the field
decisions.reason: Here "the people" means Israel's fighting men, camped against an enemy town (verse 16).

decisions.choice: Gibbethon: a town on the border with the Philistines
decisions.reason: Gibbethon had been given to Dan (Joshua 19:44) but was held by the Philistines. Nadab was besieging it when Baasha killed him (15:27), and Israel's army was there again at Zimri's coup, perhaps a generation later.

decisions.choice: seven days: the shortest reign of any king of Israel
decisions.reason: Zimri's reign ended within the week, as verses 16-18 tell.

decisions.choice: the troops (Balanced); the army (Readable)
decisions.reason: Where "the people" means the army in the field, Literal keeps "the people" and Balanced and Readable say so plainly.

decisions.choice: ready to attack it
decisions.reason: Readable explains that "encamped against" a town means besieging it.

decisions.choice: "el pueblo" (L); "las tropas" (B); "el ejército" (R)
decisions.reason: "The people" meaning the army, as the Samuel note sets for Spanish; recorded once for this block.

decisions.choice: "le peuple" (L); "les troupes" (B); "l’armée" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: "the people" meaning the army is "le peuple" at Literal and the troops or army at Balanced and Readable, for the whole block.

decisions.choice: watu (Literal); askari (Balanced); jeshi (Readable)
decisions.reason: "The people" meaning the army is "watu" at Literal and "askari" or "jeshi" at Balanced and Readable, as the Samuel note sets.

decisions.choice: "dân chúng" (L); "quân lính" (B); "quân đội" (R) for "the people" as the army
decisions.reason: As the Samuel note: the army is the ordinary word for people at Literal and troops or army at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "백성" (L), "군대", "군인들" (B, R) for the people as an army
decisions.reason: As the Samuel note settles for all five languages: "the people" meaning the army is the ordinary word at Literal and the army at Balanced and Readable. Held through the block.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע הָעָם֙ הַחֹנִ֣ים לֵאמֹ֔ר קָשַׁ֣ר זִמְרִ֔י וְגַ֖ם הִכָּ֣ה אֶת־הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיַּמְלִ֣כוּ כָֽל־יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל אֶת־עָמְרִ֨י שַׂר־צָבָ֧א עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And heard the people encamping, saying, has conspired Zimri and also has struck the king; and made king all Israel Omri, commander of [the] army, over Israel on the day the that in the camp.

en.L: And the people who were encamped heard, saying, "Zimri has conspired, and he has also struck down the king." And all Israel made Omri, the commander of the army, king over Israel on that day in the camp.
en.B: When the troops in the camp heard it said, "Zimri has plotted, and he has even struck down the king," all Israel made Omri, the commander of the army, king over Israel that very day in the camp.
en.R: The soldiers in the camp heard people say, "Zimri has made plans against the king, and he has killed him!" So that same day, there in the camp, all the Israelites made Omri, the army commander, king over Israel.

es.L: Y oyó el pueblo que estaba acampado decir: «Zimri ha conspirado, y también ha matado al rey». Y todo Israel hizo rey sobre Israel a Omri, jefe del ejército, aquel día en el campamento.
es.B: Cuando las tropas que estaban en el campamento oyeron decir: «Zimri ha conspirado, y hasta ha matado al rey», todo Israel proclamó rey sobre Israel a Omri, el jefe del ejército, ese mismo día en el campamento.
es.R: Los soldados del campamento oyeron a la gente decir: «¡Zimri ha conspirado contra el rey y lo ha matado!». Así que ese mismo día, allí en el campamento, todos los israelitas hicieron rey de Israel a Omri, el jefe del ejército.

fr.L: Et le peuple qui campait entendit dire : « Zimri a conspiré, et il a même frappé le roi. » Et tout Israël fit roi Omri, chef de l’armée, sur Israël, ce jour-là, dans le camp.
fr.B: Quand les troupes qui campaient entendirent dire : « Zimri a comploté, et il a même abattu le roi », tout Israël fit roi sur Israël Omri, le chef de l’armée, le jour même, dans le camp.
fr.R: Les soldats qui étaient dans le camp ont entendu dire : « Zimri a comploté contre le roi, et il l’a tué ! » Alors le jour même, là, dans le camp, tous les Israélites ont fait d’Omri, le chef de l’armée, le roi d’Israël.

sw.L: Watu waliokuwa wamepiga kambi wakasikia, wakisema, "Zimri amefanya fitina, tena amempiga mfalme." Israeli wote wakamfanya Omri, jemadari wa jeshi, mfalme juu ya Israeli siku ile kambini.
sw.B: Askari waliokuwa kambini waliposikia ikisemwa, "Zimri amepanga njama, hata amemuua mfalme," Israeli wote wakamfanya Omri, mkuu wa jeshi, mfalme juu ya Israeli siku ile ile huko kambini.
sw.R: Askari waliokuwa kambini walisikia watu wakisema, "Zimri amefanya njama dhidi ya mfalme, naye amemuua!" Kwa hiyo siku ile ile, pale pale kambini, Waisraeli wote wakamfanya Omri, mkuu wa jeshi, kuwa mfalme juu ya Israeli.

vi.L: Dân chúng đang đóng trại nghe người ta nói: "Xim-ri đã mưu phản và cũng đã giết vua." Ngay ngày ấy, trong trại quân, cả Y-sơ-ra-ên lập Ôm-ri, tướng chỉ huy quân đội, làm vua trên Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Khi quân lính trong trại nghe tin: "Xim-ri đã mưu phản và còn giết vua nữa," thì ngay ngày ấy, trong trại quân, cả Y-sơ-ra-ên lập Ôm-ri, tướng chỉ huy quân đội, làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Binh sĩ trong trại nghe người ta nói: "Xim-ri đã âm mưu chống lại vua và đã giết vua rồi!" Vậy ngay ngày hôm ấy, tại trại quân, toàn quân Y-sơ-ra-ên lập Ôm-ri, vị tướng chỉ huy quân đội, làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 진을 치고 있던 백성이 "시므리가 반역하여 왕을 쳤다" 하는 말을 들었다. 그러자 온 이스라엘이 그날 진영에서 군대 사령관 오므리를 이스라엘 위에 왕으로 세웠다.
ko.B: 진영에 있던 군인들은 "시므리가 반역하여 왕까지 쳐 죽였다" 하는 소문을 들었다. 그러자 온 이스라엘은 바로 그날 진영에서 군대 사령관 오므리를 이스라엘의 왕으로 세웠다.
ko.R: 진에 있던 군인들은 사람들이 "시므리가 왕에게 반역하여 왕을 죽였다!" 하고 말하는 것을 들었다. 그래서 그날 바로 그 진영에서 모든 이스라엘 군인이 군대 사령관 오므리를 이스라엘의 왕으로 세웠다.

pt.L: E o povo que estava acampado ouviu dizer: "Zinri conspirou, e também feriu o rei." E todo o Israel fez Onri, o comandante do exército, rei sobre Israel naquele dia, no acampamento.
pt.B: Quando as tropas no acampamento ouviram dizer: "Zinri conspirou e até matou o rei", todo o Israel fez de Onri, o comandante do exército, rei sobre Israel naquele mesmo dia, no acampamento.
pt.R: Os soldados no acampamento ouviram o povo dizer: "Zinri fez planos contra o rei e o matou!" Então, naquele mesmo dia, ali no acampamento, todos os israelitas fizeram Onri, o comandante do exército, rei de Israel.

decisions.choice: all Israel: Israel's fighting men gathered at the camp
decisions.reason: The ones who make Omri king are the army in the field. In verses 21-22 the people as a whole are divided over him.

decisions.choice: Omri, commander of the army: the general set against the chariot officer
decisions.reason: The army chose its own commander over Zimri, who commanded only half the chariots (verse 9). Omri's family background is not given.

decisions.choice: saying: the report as it went round the camp
decisions.reason: The word introduces the news in the words people used.

decisions.choice: all the Israelites (there in the camp)
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that "all Israel" here means those in the camp (m1).

decisions.choice: "Omri, el jefe del ejército"
decisions.reason: Omri as the terms table sets; "jefe del ejército" as the Samuel note sets for the army commander.

decisions.choice: jemadari wa jeshi (Literal); mkuu wa jeshi (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The commander of the army is "jemadari wa jeshi" at Literal and "mkuu wa jeshi" at Balanced and Readable, as the Samuel note sets.

decisions.choice: "tướng chỉ huy quân đội"
